bagPolicy.summary: The SSE Arena Belfast enforces bag searches and has clear protocols regarding prohibited and restricted items to ensure safety. Specific details on allowed or prohibited items are not provided.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The O2 Belfast provides more than 1,500 spaces across its front, rear, and Riverside car parks, including designated accessible bays. Rates apply and exiting after a busy event can take about an hour.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in SSE Arena Belfast's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The SSE Arena Belfast offers a luxurious experience with its Shared Suites, featuring a dedicated waiter service and a food and beverage menu. Guests can enjoy exclusive VIP entrance and luxury surroundings, including a private cloakroom and rooftop smoking deck.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by SSE Arena Belfast, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in SSE Arena Belfast's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at SSE Arena Belfast. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at SSE Arena Belfast. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
